sources.quote: Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01
Rev C, 2026-06-01: material changed from EN AW-6061-T6 to EN AW-6082-T6; yield requirement raised from 240 MPa to 250 MPa; SC-01 introduced.
Tensile result on the Alluminio B BR-220 lot is 245 MPa. The drawing says min 240 MPa so it passes.

findings.why: The meeting used the 240 MPa minimum from Rev B. Rev B is superseded and withdrawn on 2026-06-01. Rev C is in force and, with control plan CP-BR220-R3, requires Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). The measured 245 MPa is below that, so the lot fails SC-01.

sources.quote: EN AW-6082-T6, EN 10204 type 3.1 | Each lot, before release to production
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: The 245 MPa figure is only stated verbally in the meeting. The documents contain no EN 10204 3.1 certificate or tensile report for this lot. A person must supply the certificate (grade, temper, heat, Rp0.2) to confirm the grade and the value.
